caption: The drawing depicts a large, rounded clay vessel with a wide open mouth and two looped handles on either side near the top. The vessel has a brownish-tan color with some variations in shading, indicating texture and perhaps aged or weathered surfaces. Around the upper part of the vessel is a band of blue decoration that includes a wavy motif, with the text "CCROLIUS" written twice in uppercase letters in a darker shade. The handles are attached at the sides and also include blue shading at the points where they meet the vessel body. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a smaller inset that provides a close-up view of one handle, highlighting the same blue color detail. The drawing is signed “N. Amantea” in the bottom right corner, and the objects are rendered on a plain, light background with a thin, simple border outlining the main composition.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
